musk.definition:
n. an odorous glandular secretion from the male musk deer; used as a perfume fixative
n. the scent of a greasy glandular secretion from the male musk deer
musk.translation:
n. 麝香, 麝香的气味
[化] 麝香

musk duck.translation:
na. (原产南美的)(澳洲)麝香鸭
[网络] 麝鸭

musk plant.translation: 【植物】香沟酸浆;麝香酸浆(Mimulus moschatus) [亦作 musk flower]

musk root.translation: [医] 麝香树根, 五福花根

musk turtle.translation: [动物]麝龟[栖居于北美洲和中美洲、非洲侧颈龟属（Sternotherus）的几种水生龟中的一种]

muskat.translation: [网络] 斯卡特；慕斯卡特；穆什卡特

muskegon.translation: n. 马斯基根（美国密歇根州西部港市）

muskellunge.definition:
n. flesh of very large North American pike; a game fish
n. large (60 to 80 pounds) sport fish of North America

musken's tonometer.translation: [医] 马斯肯氏张力计(测跟腱张力)

musket.definition: n. a muzzle-loading shoulder gun with a long barrel; formerly used by infantrymen

musket ball.translation: [网络] 步丵枪弹；子弹；火枪子弹

musketeer.definition: n. a foot soldier armed with a musket

musketeers.definition: n. a foot soldier armed with a musket

musketoon.definition:
n. A short musket.
n. One who is armed with such a musket.
musketoon.translation: n. 短火枪,短滑膛枪(枪身短、枪膛大的火枪)

musketry.definition:
n. musketeers and their muskets collectively
n. the technique of using small arms (especially in battle)
musketry.translation: n. 步枪, 步兵部队, 步枪射击术

muskets.definition: n. a muzzle-loading shoulder gun with a long barrel; formerly used by infantrymen
muskets.translation: n. <史>火枪, （尤指）滑膛枪( musket的复数形式 )

muskhogean.definition:
n a member of any of the peoples formerly living in southeastern United States and speaking Muskhogean languages
n a family of North American Indian languages spoken in the southeastern United States
muskhogean.translation: n. (北美印第安语群中的)马斯科吉语组

muskier.definition:
comparative of musky
s. resembling the smell of musk
muskier.translation: (musky 的比较级) a. 麝香的, 产生麝香的, 麝香似的

muskiness.definition: n. having the olfactory properties of musk
muskiness.translation: n. 麝香, 产生麝香

muskmelon.definition: n. the fruit of a muskmelon vine; any of several sweet melons related to cucumbers

muskogean.definition:
n a member of any of the peoples formerly living in southeastern United States and speaking Muskhogean languages
n a family of North American Indian languages spoken in the southeastern United States
muskogean.translation: n. (北美印第安语群中的)马斯科吉语组

muskogee.definition:
n. a member of the Muskhogean people formerly living in Georgia and eastern Alabama and constituting the core of the Creek Confederacy
n. a town in eastern Oklahoma on the Arkansas River
n. the Muskhogean language spoken by the Muskogee
muskogee.translation: n. 马斯科吉（美国城市）；马斯科吉人；马斯科吉语

muskogees.definition:
n. pl. A powerful tribe of North American Indians that
   formerly occupied the region of Georgia, Florida, and Alabama. They
   constituted a large part of the Creek confederacy.
muskogees.translation: n. 马斯科吉（美国城市）；马斯科吉人；马斯科吉语 (Muskogee的变形)

muskoka.translation: n. 穆斯科卡，位于加拿大安大略省，是著名的蜜月圣地。

muskrat.definition:
n. the brown fur of a muskrat
n. beaver-like aquatic rodent of North America with dark glossy brown fur

muskrats.definition:
plural of muskrat
n. the brown fur of a muskrat
n. beaver-like aquatic rodent of North America with dark glossy brown fur

musks.definition:
plural of musk
n. an odorous glandular secretion from the male musk deer; used as a perfume fixative
n. the scent of a greasy glandular secretion from the male musk deer
musks.translation:
(musk 的复数) n. 麝香, 麝香的气味
[化] 麝香

muskwood.definition: n musk-scented shrub or tree of southern and southeastern Australia having creamy-yellow flower heads

musky.definition: s. resembling the smell of musk
musky.translation: a. 麝香的, 产生麝香的, 麝香似的
